prompt: Wide 16:9 background plate for a hand-pixeled side-scrolling fantasy RPG in a Chinese jade mountain valley. Crisp 1990s storybook pixel art with restrained palette, distinct large readable shapes, layered side elevation and atmospheric light. Quiet open lower middle for overlaying characters and gameplay platforms; rich detail at perimeter. No sprites, people, monsters, lettering, HUD, framing or panels.

scenes.prompt: A riverside flagstone road, jade green water and a low stone parapet under a lone red-leaf elm, layered pale blue karst peaks.
A shady riverside limestone grotto, a huge network of pale roots curling over its roof and a shaft of emerald sunlight. An old animal lair with no animals.
A high airy stack of angled pale limestone ledges, a single crooked pine clinging to the right crag, and a sea of blue morning cloud below.
A cliff-top hill scout lookout built from wooden poles and a torn pennant overlooking a bright windswept valley. No inhabitants.
A Chinese river ferry landing at amber sunset: short wooden jetty at left, a small roofed ferry tied up behind it, broad green still water and silhouetted karst.
An abandoned half-flooded Chinese river shrine beneath the ferry road. Weathered carved stone lintels frame a cyan pool, faded violet hanging cloth, dry walking bank.
A warm red-earth trail winding across the southern shoulder of a jagged Chinese mountain, bamboo shade near camera, a weathered stone pass marker and mossy switchbacks.
Sheltered hollow beneath a mountain trail: large curling ferns, an old mossy fallen pine, dappled gold sunlight on reddish soil, blue limestone in the distance.
